An '''adamant sword''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Sword|diamond sword]] with [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. It deals 8 damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_sword.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/adamant/sword</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===

It deals 8 damage with an attack speed of 1.6.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Sharpness]] I
* {{G|Weakness}} Weakness: gives the target Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit, which feeds adamant armor's [[Doom]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>
* [[Unbreaking]] II

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Adamant equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
A [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] of level 2 (Apprentice) buys it for one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_sword.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. [[Divinity]] was removed from adamant weapons and replaced with Sharpness. The real attack speed and damage now match the tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Adamant weapons now inflict Weakness.}}
}}
